q: Can a hybrid solar tray dryer cut wood use in a chemical drying room, and by how much?
title: Hybrid solar tray dryer: wood saved
short: Yes. BEE's Ahmedabad report has a 96-tray hybrid run 14 hours on solar-heated air and 16 on an efficient wood heater per 30 hour batch, saving 658 kg of wood a batch, 108.5 t a year. Cost Rs 8.01 lakh, payback 2.77 years (2010). Reported fossil CO2 barely changes.
audience: Chemical and dye units in Ahmedabad choosing between an efficient wood-heated tray dryer and a solar hybrid for the same 96-tray load

p: A solar panel heats air that is drawn into an insulated 96-tray cabinet. The report assumes 7 to 10 hours of usable sun a day. When the sun goes, digital controls switch the dryer to an efficient wood-fired hot air generator.
Per batch: 14 hours on solar, 16 hours on wood at 10.73 kg an hour, about 172 kg of wood, against 829 kg in the old 96-tray dryer.

sections.h: Hybrid or efficient dryer: same report series, side by side
ul: Efficient dryer: Rs 3.86 lakh, 507 kg wood saved a batch, 130 batches, Rs 1.69 lakh a year, 2.28 years.
Hybrid solar: Rs 8.01 lakh, 658 kg wood saved a batch, 165 batches, Rs 2.89 lakh a year, 2.77 years.
The two reports assume different batch counts. At the same 130 batches, the hybrid saves about 85.5 t of wood, about Rs 2.27 lakh net, and pays back in about 3.5 years.
Per batch, the hybrid's extra Rs 4.15 lakh buys about 150 kg more wood saved.

sections.h: What it does to your footprint
p: The report claims 76 t of CO2 saved. That is wood CO2, which is biogenic and reported separately. In Scope 1 the methane and nitrous oxide from 108.5 t of wood are about 3.2 t CO2e; the dryer's 7,385 kWh are about 5.0 t in Scope 2. Reported fossil CO2 rises by about 2 t. The gain is wood and money, not Scope 1.

ul: Count your real batches a year; the payback depends on it.
Check roof or yard space facing south for the panel, free of shade most of the day.
Expect less solar hours in the monsoon months, and plan the wood heater for full load then.
Ask the supplier for the solar panel's area and its air temperature at your batch's moisture.

example.title: 165 batches a year, per the report (estimate)
lines: Money: 108.5 t x Rs 3,000 = Rs 3.26 lakh, less 7,385 kWh x Rs 5 = Rs 0.37 lakh: Rs 2.89 lakh
Scope 1 methane and nitrous oxide avoided: 108.5 x 0.030 = 3.2 t CO2e
Biogenic CO2 avoided, reported separately: about 190 t
example.note: Wood at IPCC 2006 defaults with AR6 warming potentials; grid CEA FY 2025-26. The 130-batch comparison applies the report's per batch saving and costs to fewer batches.

senseible: Senseible reads your power bills into monthly CO2 records, so the dryer's extra kWh are counted. It has no built-in wood factor; weigh wood bought and use the figures worked out here. The green loan check covers what a lender wants for solar thermal equipment.
